title: Kenyan Roast with Hojicha Glaze
description: A deliciously juicy and flavorful Kenyan-style roast featuring hojicha, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This keto-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with herbs.
instructions: Season the beef chuck roast with salt, black pepper, rosemary, and thyme.
Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef chuck roast until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef chuck roast to a large baking dish and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the Dutch oven and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the hojicha grounds to the Dutch oven and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the potatoes to the Dutch oven and toss to coat with the hojicha mixture.
Pour the hojicha glaze over the potatoes and toss to coat.
Return the beef chuck roast to the baking dish and pour the remaining hojicha glaze over the top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef chuck roast reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the beef chuck roast is nicely browned.
Let the beef chuck roast rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
